idea.title: Update the established variant files instead of creating parallel drafts
idea.summary: Format adaptation now updates the existing files in content/drafts/format and documents those exact paths across the workflow instructions.

context.goal: Apply approved platform adaptations using the project's established draft file locations.
context.situation: The existing Carousel and LinkedIn drafts were stored under content/drafts/format, but the workflow instructions named root-level paths.
context.problem: Following the stale paths created parallel root-level variant files instead of updating the existing drafts.
context.investigation: Compared the existing draft tree with the playbook, lifecycle documentation, and README output paths.
context.decision: Update the existing format drafts in place, remove the parallel files, and align the workflow path instructions with the actual repository structure.
context.implementation: Replaced content/drafts/format/carousel.md and content/drafts/format/linkedin.md with the approved adaptations; updated Workflow 04 and matching lifecycle and README references.
context.result: The adaptations reside only under content/drafts/format, and documentation explicitly directs future runs to edit those existing files.

learning_points: Check existing project paths before creating workflow outputs.
When implementation and documentation disagree, update the relevant source-of-truth paths together.
An explicit in-place update instruction helps prevent duplicate draft artifacts.
story_points: Variant files already existed in a dedicated format directory.
The workflow's root-level output paths caused parallel files to be created.
The correction updated existing drafts and aligned path references across the workflow documents.
possible_angles: How checking the repository tree can prevent duplicate workflow outputs.
Keep documentation paths aligned with where a project actually stores its files.

resources.description: Short excerpt of the corrected existing-file output contract.
